description.en: Turn cross-feature questions into a checklist, start with the smallest useful overview, and trace entry points, data and state changes while recording evidence and coverage gaps.

title.zh: 约束版本比较的结论

description.zh: 比较制品、函数或证据集合时保留比较范围；静态变化只是行为变化的候选线索，缺失或不完整结果继续记为未知。
description.en: Artifact, function and evidence-set comparisons retain their scope. Static changes are candidate behavioral clues, while missing or incomplete coverage remains unknown.

title.zh: 核对静态线索与被动观察
title.en: Reconcile static clues with passive observations

description.zh: 对已经打开的浏览器或 Electron 目标采集被动证据，再与静态应用证据核对；脚本出现不代表其中每个模块都执行过。
description.en: Collect passive evidence from an already-open browser or Electron target and reconcile it with static application evidence. Seeing a script does not prove every module executed.

title.zh: 确定制品和调查问题

description.zh: 提供明确的本地制品、目标应用或已有捕获，并列出要回答的行为问题。
description.en: Provide a specific local artifact, target application or existing capture and list the behavior questions to answer.

title.zh: 选择可用的分析入口

description.zh: 按目标类型检查对应工具；只在连接缺失或过期时诊断配置，复用匹配的已有证据。
description.en: Choose tools by target type. Diagnose configuration only when the connection is absent or stale, and reuse matching evidence.

title.zh: 围绕证据缺口补充分析

description.zh: 先看摘要与证据，只有问题尚未回答时才做聚焦查询或所需的运行观察。
description.en: Read summaries and evidence first, then make focused queries or runtime observations only for questions that remain unanswered.

title.zh: 交付带边界的调查结论

description.zh: 把每个问题标为已回答、部分回答或未解决，关联证据编号，区分观察、推断和未知。
description.en: Mark each question answered, partially answered or unresolved; link evidence identifiers and distinguish observations, inferences and unknowns.

primaryCapability.zh: 用 Markdown 草稿生成可修订的 HTML 讲解页
primaryCapability.en: Turn Markdown drafts into editable HTML explainers

summary.zh: Answer me with HTML 让模型负责内容草稿，由捆绑的 Node.js CLI 完成页面布局与图示。流程、时序、目录、时间线和方案比较可用专用语法表达，生成后还能按面板局部修订。适合把复杂回答整理成可浏览的单页，而不是手写整套 HTML 与 CSS。
summary.en: Answer me with HTML leaves the content draft to the model and delegates layout and diagrams to a bundled Node.js CLI. Dedicated syntax covers flows, sequences, trees, timelines and comparisons, with panel-level edits after generation. It suits complex answers that benefit from a browsable page without hand-writing the HTML and CSS.

bestFor.zh: 要解释调用链、架构、状态变化或多维方案取舍，希望读者看清关系的开发者与写作者。
bestFor.en: Developers and writers explaining call chains, architecture, state changes or multidimensional trade-offs where relationships need to be visible.

bestFor.zh: 需要反复修改讲解材料，希望只更新一个面板并保留页面主题的用户。
bestFor.en: Users iterating on explainers who want to update one panel while retaining the page’s theme.

skillFluxNote.zh: 已完整收录 Skill 正文、设置和视频引用，以及内含模板、CSS、JavaScript 的 scripts/am.mjs，并保留许可证。以下为固定版本的文件分析，未宣称本次已渲染页面或视频；包仍在 intake，尚未通过 MCP 安装审核。
skillFluxNote.en: The complete skill includes its instructions, settings and video guides, and scripts/am.mjs with bundled templates, CSS and JavaScript, plus licenses. This is a file-based analysis of a pinned version, not a claim that pages or videos were rendered in this review. The package remains in intake pending MCP installation review.

limitations.zh: 页面生成需要 Node.js 20+ 和本地命令权限；其他宿主需正确解析 Skill 所在路径。生成结果可离线查看，后台版本检查可能访问 GitHub。
limitations.en: Page generation needs Node.js 20+ and local command access. Other hosts must resolve the skill directory correctly. Generated pages work offline, while background version checks may contact GitHub.

limitations.zh: 视频仅用于明确的视频请求；文件导出需要 Chrome 和 Node.js 22+，MP4 还需 ffmpeg。语音设置可能选择外部服务；引用本地代码后，应检查页面是否包含不宜分享的内容。
limitations.en: Video is for explicit video requests. File export needs Chrome and Node.js 22+, with ffmpeg also required for MP4. Voice settings may select an external service; inspect pages containing local code before sharing.

github-com-bradautomates-claude-video.zh: 如果主要交付物是视频，优先比较 Claude Video 的视频流程；此 Skill 的主要入口仍是 HTML 讲解页。
github-com-bradautomates-claude-video.en: Compare Claude Video when video is the main deliverable; this skill’s primary entry point is the HTML explainer.

github-com-anthropics-skills.zh: 如果需要文档、演示等多种交付格式，可比较 Anthropic 的对应技能；此 Skill 更聚焦单页讲解。
github-com-anthropics-skills.en: Compare the relevant Anthropic skills for multiple document or presentation formats; this skill focuses on single-page explanations.

title.zh: 让信息形状决定组件

description.zh: 关系用 flow，参与方消息用 sequence，目录用 tree，演变用 timeline，多维取舍用表格；先拆问题，再选择表达方式。
description.en: Use flow for relationships, sequence for messages, tree for hierarchy, timeline for evolution and tables for multidimensional trade-offs. Decompose the question before choosing its representation.

title.zh: 把草稿交给捆绑渲染器

description.zh: 模型写扩展 Markdown 和面板标题，CLI 处理布局、主题、深浅色与图示坐标，并报告格式错误或写作警告。
description.en: The model writes extended Markdown and panel titles. The CLI handles layout, themes, light/dark mode and diagram coordinates, then reports syntax errors or writing warnings.

title.zh: 局部改稿与结构对比
title.en: Patch a panel and show structural changes

description.zh: patch 可按面板标题或编号更新已有页面；流程与目录支持新增、删除和修改标记，帮助说明重构或方案变化。
description.en: patch updates an existing page by panel title or identifier. Flow and tree components support addition, deletion and change markers for explaining refactors or plan changes.

title.zh: 按需扩展为讲解视频
title.en: Extend an explainer into video on request

description.zh: 明确要求视频时使用分场景草稿，生成带章节和播放控制的页面；语音与 MP4/WebM 导出属于额外分支。
description.en: An explicit video request uses a scene-based draft to produce a player with chapters and playback controls. Narration and MP4/WebM export are additional branches.

title.zh: 界定页面要回答的问题

description.zh: 把复杂问题拆成几个面板，每个面板只回答一个子问题，开头写清主要结论。
description.en: Divide the complex question into panels, each answering one sub-question, and state the main conclusion first.

title.zh: 编写结构化草稿

description.zh: 根据关系、时序、层级或比较选择组件语法；使用真实数据，标明示例与引用代码。
description.en: Choose syntax for relationships, sequences, hierarchy or comparisons. Use real data and label illustrative examples and quoted code.

title.zh: 渲染并检查反馈

description.zh: 运行捆绑 CLI，检查输出路径、组件错误和写作警告；必要时修订草稿并重新渲染。
description.en: Run the bundled CLI and inspect the output path, component errors and writing warnings. Revise and render again when needed.

title.zh: 交付页面并按面板迭代
title.en: Share the page and iterate by panel

description.zh: 用生成文件路径交付页面；后续只改相关面板，分享前检查嵌入的本地代码和材料。
description.en: Deliver the generated file path, update only the relevant panel during later revisions, and inspect embedded local code and material before sharing.

primaryCapability.zh: 评估科研证据，并筛选可追溯的研究方向
primaryCapability.en: Appraise scientific evidence and prioritize traceable research directions

summary.zh: 本次从 K-Dense 合集中精选两项研究方法 Skill：scientific-critical-thinking 用于检查主张、设计和证据边界，scientific-brainstorming 用于独立生成想法、明确评价标准并记录决策。另完整保存 scientific-schematics 作为可选图示支持；本页分析这组已选能力，不将整个科研工具库视为已收录。
summary.en: This selection from K-Dense covers two research-method skills: scientific-critical-thinking examines claims, study design and evidence limits, while scientific-brainstorming supports independent idea generation, explicit criteria and decision records. scientific-schematics is preserved as optional diagram support. This page analyzes that selection without implying the entire scientific toolkit was collected.

bestFor.zh: 拿到论文或科学主张后，需要定位证据、区分偏倚风险与证据确定性的研究者。
bestFor.en: Researchers who need to locate evidence behind a paper or scientific claim and distinguish risk of bias from certainty of evidence.

bestFor.zh: 处于选题阶段，需要保留不同意见、评价依据和后续验证任务的研究团队。
bestFor.en: Research teams choosing directions who need to preserve dissent, evaluation reasons and follow-up validation tasks.

skillFluxNote.zh: 完整收录范围为两个主技能及 scientific-schematics 支持技能，包含引用、脚本和 MIT 许可证，保留原始目录关系。三项均在 intake，未完成 MCP 安装与行为审核；本页是固定快照分析，不能作为科研结论或运行验收。
skillFluxNote.en: The complete selection contains the two main skills and scientific-schematics, including references, scripts and MIT licenses with the original directory layout. All three remain in intake pending MCP installation and behavioral review. This pinned-snapshot analysis is not a scientific finding or execution acceptance test.

limitations.zh: 核心分析指引可离线使用；头脑风暴的可选本地工具需要 Python 3.11+，只做结构与评分记录检查，不验证科学真实性。
limitations.en: Core analytical guidance works offline. Optional brainstorming utilities need Python 3.11+ and check structure or scoring records, not scientific truth.

limitations.zh: 图示支持需 Python、requests、OpenRouter 密钥和联网，并向外部服务发送内容。生成的是 PNG 草图，仍需人工核查标签与关系；想法评分也不能代替验证或专业审查。
limitations.en: Diagram support needs Python, requests, an OpenRouter key and network access, and sends content to an external service. It produces PNG drafts whose labels and relationships need human checking; idea scores do not replace validation or expert review.

github-com-brycewang-stanford-auto-empir.zh: 若问题已经落到实证经济学的识别策略、分析计划和复现包，可比较 AERS 本次精选的阶段性工作流。
github-com-brycewang-stanford-auto-empir.en: Compare the selected AERS workflows when the task concerns empirical-economics identification, analysis planning and replication packages.

github-com-anthropics-skills.zh: 若研究内容已经确定，主要需要整理文档或演示交付，可比较 Anthropic 的格式与文档技能。
github-com-anthropics-skills.en: Compare Anthropic’s document and presentation skills when research content is settled and the main need is preparing deliverables.

title.zh: 先提取证据，再评价主张
title.en: Extract evidence before judging a claim

description.zh: 从研究问题、样本单位、结果、分母和不确定性开始，检查设计与分析是否支持所声称的结论，并区分未报告与未执行。
description.en: Start with the question, sampling unit, results, denominators and uncertainty. Check whether design and analysis support the claim, while distinguishing missing reporting from a procedure not performed.

title.zh: 输出可追溯的研究批评

description.zh: 按严重程度整理问题，每项写明来源位置、观察、对结论的影响和可行补救；报告完整性、偏倚风险与证据确定性分别处理。
description.en: Organize concerns by severity with a source location, observation, effect on the claim and feasible remedy. Treat reporting completeness, risk of bias and evidence certainty separately.

title.zh: 让研究选题保留分歧与依据
title.en: Preserve reasoning and dissent in ideation

description.zh: 先独立生成想法，再归类、定义评价标准、进行反对性审视并查证文献；记录原始评分、假设、异议和最终决策理由。
description.en: Generate ideas independently before clustering, defining criteria, adversarial review and literature checks. Retain raw ratings, assumptions, dissent and the final decision rationale.

title.zh: 可选生成科研图示草稿

description.zh: scientific-schematics 接收有依据的图示描述，保存 PNG 草稿和审查日志；模型评分只辅助修订，不等于期刊质量验收。
description.en: scientific-schematics accepts source-backed diagram descriptions and saves PNG drafts with review logs. Model scores help guide revision rather than establish journal acceptance.

title.zh: 选择评估或选题入口

description.zh: 提供要评价的主张和材料，或一个明确的研究选题问题；记录目标、已知信息与未知项。
description.en: Provide a claim and its materials for appraisal or a focused question for ideation, recording goals, known information and unknowns.

title.zh: 保留证据和想法来源

description.zh: 评估时提取结果及其位置；选题时先独立生成，给想法稳定编号并标明假设、预测和来源。
description.en: For appraisal, extract results with their locations. For ideation, generate independently and assign stable IDs with assumptions, predictions and provenance.

title.zh: 应用对应的评价规则

description.zh: 按研究设计选择评估框架，或事先定义选题标准，再检查替代解释、分歧和证据缺口。
description.en: Choose appraisal frameworks for the study design or define ideation criteria in advance, then examine alternative explanations, disagreement and evidence gaps.

title.zh: 形成有边界的下一步

description.zh: 交付可追溯批评或决策记录，列出仍需检索、验证和专业审查的事项；图示仅在需要时另行生成。
description.en: Deliver a traceable critique or decision log with remaining searches, validation and expert review tasks. Generate diagrams separately when needed.

primaryCapability.zh: 串联实证研究的识别、分析计划与复现交付
primaryCapability.en: Connect empirical identification, analysis planning and replication delivery

summary.zh: SkillFlux 从 AERS 中采用 MIT 许可的 AER-skills 子合集精选预注册、识别策略和复现三个主技能。它们把研究问题连接到估计目标、分析计划、诊断检查与复现包；同时收录稳健性、StatsPAI 和图表三个支持技能，以及所需模板、公共脚本、引用与示例。
summary.en: SkillFlux selected preregistration, identification and replication from the MIT-licensed AER-skills subcollection within AERS. These skills connect research questions to estimands, analysis plans, diagnostics and replication packages. The selection also preserves robustness, StatsPAI and tables/figures support skills with required templates, shared scripts, references and examples.

bestFor.zh: 已有实证经济学研究问题，需要明确识别假设、估计方法与诊断报告的研究者。
bestFor.en: Empirical-economics researchers who need to specify identifying assumptions, estimators and diagnostic reports for an existing question.

bestFor.zh: 准备实验分析计划，或需要把数据来源、脚本和论文图表整理成可复现交付的团队。
bestFor.en: Teams preparing an experimental analysis plan or organizing data provenance, scripts and manuscript exhibits into a reproducible deliverable.

skillFluxNote.zh: 主选 aer-preregistration、aer-identification、aer-replication；支持项为 aer-robustness、aer-statspai、aer-tables-figures。已完整保存这组技能及所需公共资源，目前均为 intake，未通过 MCP 安装审核。本页依据固定版本正文拆解，不表示已验证估计结果或完成研究注册。
skillFluxNote.en: Main selections are aer-preregistration, aer-identification and aer-replication, supported by aer-robustness, aer-statspai and aer-tables-figures. These skills and required shared resources are fully preserved and remain in intake pending MCP installation review. This analysis of pinned instructions does not claim validated estimates or completed research registration.

limitations.zh: MIT 许可只对应本次选定的 AER-skills 子合集；外围 AERS 的其他来源许可各异。StatsPAI MCP、统计软件、数据访问与注册服务均不是收录目录自带的运行环境。
limitations.en: MIT applies to the selected AER-skills subcollection, while other sources in AERS have different terms. StatsPAI MCP, statistical software, data access and registration services are separate from the collected files.

limitations.zh: 模板与方法分支是研究起点，须结合数据和识别假设核查；不能据清单完成情况保证因果有效性或期刊接受。注册和提交要求还需以实际平台与期刊当时的规则为准。
limitations.en: Templates and method branches are starting points to assess against the data and identifying assumptions. Completing a checklist cannot guarantee causal validity or journal acceptance; registration and submission requirements must be checked with the relevant platform and journal.

github-com-k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-s.zh: 若仍在研究选题或证据批判阶段，可比较 K-Dense 本次精选的 brainstorming 与 critical-thinking，再进入具体实证设计。
github-com-k-dense-ai-scientific-agent-s.en: Compare the selected K-Dense brainstorming and critical-thinking skills when the task is still research ideation or evidence appraisal, before a specific empirical design.

github-com-othmanadi-planning-with-files.zh: 若暂不需要统计方法，只想长期保存研究计划、发现和进度，可比较 planning-with-files。
github-com-othmanadi-planning-with-files.en: Compare planning-with-files when the need is persistent research plans, findings and progress rather than statistical-method guidance.

title.zh: 把研究设计映射到识别策略
title.en: Map the design to an identification strategy

description.zh: aer-identification 按处理分配、阈值、政策时点或外生变化组织 DiD、IV、RDD、合成控制等分支，同时要求记录估计目标、诊断与推断方式。
description.en: aer-identification organizes DiD, IV, RDD, synthetic control and other branches around assignment, thresholds, policy timing or exogenous variation, with estimands, diagnostics and inference recorded.

title.zh: 将实验决策写成分析计划
title.en: Turn experimental decisions into an analysis plan

description.zh: aer-preregistration 提供 PAP 提纲，覆盖假设、主要结果、估计式、纳入规则、功效与多重检验；输出用于后续核对计划和偏离。
description.en: aer-preregistration provides a PAP outline covering hypotheses, primary outcomes, estimating equations, inclusion rules, power and multiplicity, supporting later comparison of the plan with deviations.

title.zh: 围绕主结果设计补充检查
title.en: Plan checks around the main result

description.zh: aer-robustness 将规格、样本、结果定义和推断方式的敏感性，与异质性、机制和安慰剂检查分开组织，便于说明每项检查回答什么问题。
description.en: aer-robustness separates sensitivity to specifications, samples, outcome definitions and inference from heterogeneity, mechanism and placebo checks, making each check’s question explicit.

title.zh: 把论文结果连接到复现文件
title.en: Connect manuscript results to replication files

description.zh: aer-replication 用数据来源登记、环境说明、主脚本和图表索引组织交付；每张图表应能追溯到生成脚本与输出文件。
description.en: aer-replication organizes provenance records, environment instructions, a master script and exhibit mappings so tables and figures can be traced to generating scripts and output files.

title.zh: 写清研究问题与数据条件
title.en: State the question and data conditions

description.zh: 提供处理分配方式、可用数据、时间结构和目标效应；先记录识别假设，再选择方法分支。
description.en: Describe assignment, available data, time structure and the target effect. Record identifying assumptions before choosing a method branch.

title.zh: 固定计划和执行环境
title.en: Record the plan and execution environment

description.zh: 对适用的实验或前瞻性研究准备分析计划；同时检查统计软件、包版本与可用的外部工具。
description.en: Prepare an analysis plan for applicable experimental or prospective work and check statistical software, package versions and available external tools.

title.zh: 运行分析并保留诊断
title.en: Run the analysis and retain diagnostics

description.zh: 由准备好的环境执行估计与相应检查，保存结果、图表、假设变化和计划偏离记录。
description.en: Use the prepared environment for estimation and relevant checks, retaining results, exhibits, assumption changes and deviations from the plan.

title.zh: 从干净环境核对复现包
title.en: Check replication from a clean environment

description.zh: 用主脚本重建输出，核对论文图表映射与数据来源；记录运行条件、受限数据获取方式和未解决的问题。
description.en: Rebuild outputs with the master script, check exhibit mappings and data provenance, and document runtime requirements, restricted-data access and unresolved issues.
